methodology:
NADEC (National Agricultural Development Company) is a Saudi-listed agricultural and dairy operator with 4 main agricultural projects: Wadi al-Dawasir, Hail, Haradh, and Al-Jouf. Operations include wheat, clover, corn, Rhodes grass (alfalfa-equivalent fodder), plus integrated dairy.

Saudi farmland disclosure is less granular than Western markets; the 124K-acre figure is a rough estimate. NADEC's book value (Net PP&E SAR 2,258M) includes substantial dairy + processing infrastructure, not just farmland — a stricter analysis would carve out farmland-only book.

The SAR is pegged to USD ($1 = SAR 3.75) so comp benchmarks translate cleanly between currencies. Saudi agricultural water comes from desalination and aquifer drawdown, making per-acre values higher than would be expected for arid land but with hidden long-term water-cost risk.
